protocol.estimator: arithmetic mean of all step_seconds in the stated window; no outlier removal
protocol.timing_scope: Rank-0 real-data training step, including data transfer and NCCL DDP; main-stream synchronized
protocol.initialization: MuonT step-2500 model weights; fresh optimizer/statistics; data and LR offset 2500
protocol.excludes: compilation/startup warmup, evaluation and checkpoint IO
limitations: One short benchmark per method; 60 correlated updates do not establish precise percent-level rankings.
Fresh optimizer/statistics differ from each method's own converged mid-training state.
Rank-0 timing is recorded; per-rank maxima and historical GPU occupancy were not logged.
Current workspace training implementation differs from the frozen optimized benchmark implementation.
